package.name: rover_comms
package.description: Rover end of the 433 MHz LoRa fallback link. Terminates the radio protocol driven by lora_bridge.py on the ground-station mast and republishes the operator's commands on cmd_vel_lora, which twist_mux carries at a priority below the Wi-Fi path. Counterpart to indomitus_rover_comms in the indomitus-ground-station repository.
